beats: My scraper marked almost every LinkedIn posting Easy Apply and threw it away — 643 of 644 in a month.
It hunted for a button LinkedIn stopped showing guests months ago, so real postings landed straight in the trash.
So I built a Python resolver that reads LinkedIn's own guest-page marker to spot a real application form.
It checks the posting text, then that marker, then the employer's site, before any paid search.
Out of the next thirty postings, real working links went from zero to twenty.
